text:
maria: Quick sync 10am PT Wed announcement target. Need final changelog link, docs anchors, and explicit canary timing from eng. Also confirm webinar landing for Thu 1pm PT.
ben: API freeze Tue EOD PT for any breaking changes. Changelog draft: https://docs.redwood.ai/changelog/2.1 (will push final note after QA).
liam: Docs PR going up now. Proposed anchors: #new-routing, #kv-cache, #quant-profiles. Will paste live doc URL when merged.
sara: Marketing wants a tight bench headline. Product allowed: "~50% lower per-token cost at 8k seq with smart batching". Ben, are we safe to use that?
ben: Yes on canary perf snapshot. Key metrics: `p95 latency: 120ms -> 85ms`, throughput +30% on Dedicated pool. I'll add measurement details to the changelog.
maria: Need staging preview links for CMS. @ash can staging mirror prod doc routes?
ash: Staging will mirror prod paths. Expect deploy Tue ~11:00am PT, will post staging URLs here.
deploy-bot: deploy-bot: Canary rollout scheduled: 2025-11-05T16:00:00Z 10% initial traffic on Dedicated; auto-fallback to Hosted variant if errors > 2%.
ben: Messaging note: fallback model is `vicuna-7b-quant`. Don't phrase as generic "open-source model" in hero; call out model family and a short caveat.
maria: Copy updated. Need hero image + benchmark graphic. @ania can you deliver SVG + PNG (hero + social) by EOD?
ania: Will deliver hero SVG 1200x630 and thumbnail PNG 600x315. Use brand blue #0a6cff, call out cache improvements and caption "measurements on Redwood Dedicated (nvlink enabled)".
liam: Docs merged: https://docs.redwood.ai/release/2.1 1ooks live. Anchors: #new-routing, #kv-cache, #quant-profiles.
maria: Great. I'll prep CMS for Wed 10am PT publish. Final checklist: changelog link, docs anchors, hero assets, webinar landing link, staging preview. Reply in next 2 hours if blocked. :hourglass_flowing_sand: 
ben: Also add the migration note about db index rehash for Dedicated in-place upgrades.
ash: Running pre-deploy smoke tests Tue 11:30am PT.
nash: smoke passed :rocket:
maria: Thanks all 1 will tag legal for embargo and schedule the publish. :thumbsup:
